name: Tokumei is Everywhere
source:
Tokumei, fueled by memories of that fateful night, seeks a rematch with Rosa by any means necessary. Joined by Todd and Valerie, Tokumei is back, his blood craving more action.

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3539239988]Steam Workshop[/url]]
